title: Random Color Generator
seoTitle: Free Random Color Generator — Hex Palette
description: Generate a random hex color instantly. Copy the code or generate another. Great for design inspiration and UI experiments.
intro: Click to generate a fresh random color. See the hex code, a large swatch, and copy it with one click.
blurb: Generate random hex colors for design and inspiration.
howItWorks: Press Generate new color to create a random RGB color.
The hex code appears and a colored swatch is shown.
Press Copy hex to put the code on your clipboard.
examples: Quickly pick a color for a button or background.
Generate inspiration when starting a design.
Use the hex in CSS, Figma or other tools.

faq.a: Each of the red, green and blue channels is chosen independently from 0–255 using the browser's random number generator.

faq.q: Can I generate more than one?
faq.a: Yes. Each click produces a new independent color.

faq.q: Is anything sent to a server?
faq.a: No. Color generation and copying happen entirely in your browser.
